title: Detect ROIs
description: Finds cells as connected areas of pixels that correlate with their neighbours over time: each pixel's average correlation with its 8 neighbours is thresholded, and 4-connected areas whose size is in range, away from the border, become ROIs. The ROIs are saved as JSON: imageSize and rois[{id, area, center, pixels}], with 0-based [row, column] pixels.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: ROIs
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

border.title: Border left out (px)
border.description: Pixels this close to the edge are not part of any ROI: after motion correction they are partly filled with 0, and correlate
